sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 711 numbered entries and 112 unnumbered artist entries across 22 sections are reconciled using original glyph columns. Both 200-card base and Gary Vee autograph rosters, all 100 Manga codes including SSA-100 Zealous Zombie, printed CC versus CCA autograph prefixes and source name spellings are preserved. The 104 odds categories retain eight exact format headings and every physical value; disclaimer text is not a format. Thirty-three exact guide joins and a specification-only Balance Battles Green Refractor retain family scope; the 1986 limit is a print count, not serial numbering. Guide-only signer/artist differences, explicit pack versus box/case units and the separately timed Sapphire edition remain qualified. Exhaustive numbering remains incomplete.

All 711 numbered entries and 112 artist entries are reconciled. The fused SSA-100 code is retained separately from Zealous Zombie. Guide-only artist names and a MrBeast autograph claim have no printed card-code join; no new roster entries are invented.

The combined odds sheet retains all 104 categories and eight literal formats, including Sapphire. No ratio unit is printed; only the separately sourced five variant statements explicitly name packs. Box/case averages remain separate and are not converted into pack rates.

Balance Battles Green Refractor is named in the brand guide but has no matching odds row or stated number; it remains specification-only. Other unpublished limits, including Sapphire and most base colors, are unverified. The 1986 count is a print limit, not serial numbering. Exhaustive parallel coverage is not established.
The brand confirms June 10 regular-Chrome global release separately from May presales. Sapphire launch timing is not established by that date.
